_about: Layout violations accepted on purpose. Each entry: page (a route like /holdings, or * for every page), rule (R1..R27), element (a piece of the element label shown in the report) and a reason. Only used by UI_LINT_STRICT=1 runs (npm run ui-lint) to pass; the report still lists them.

allow.reason: The three plan cards are a comparison: Free lists fewer features than Basic, and at 1280 px that shows as a shorter card. They start level, each ends at its own list with its button directly under it; stretching Free would only move the blank space inside it (R13), and filling it would be filler.

R27 (LIVE5): a table of 9 figure columns compared across a row; at 1280 the k-fit layout (words wrap, figures on one line) still leaves Checks and Actions past the box, which scrolls sideways with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs columns chosen per page, a follow-up of its own; at 1440 it is in view.

R27 (LIVE5): a table of 9 figure columns compared across a row; at 1280 the k-fit layout (words wrap, figures on one line) still leaves Qty and Rate past the box, which scrolls sideways with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs columns chosen per page, a follow-up of its own; at 1440 it is in view.

R27 (LIVE5): a table of 10 figure columns compared across a row; at 1280 the k-fit layout (words wrap, figures on one line) still leaves Price, 1 year past the box, which scrolls sideways with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs columns chosen per page, a follow-up of its own; at 1440 it is in view.

R27 (LIVE5): the brief's stock tables sit in the brief's reading column (about 480 px at 1280, beside the list of briefs); with k-fit their words wrap but the last column (Since) still scrolls with its edge shadow. Fitting it needs the brief's column wider or the table's columns chosen per width, a follow-up of its own.
